title: Figure with a margin note: a bordered panel with a residual-stream schematic (blocks reading and writing through mauve arrows), token tiles, a numbered caption and a margin note with a thumbnail in the right gutter
use: A schematic figure with its numbered caption and the aside that rides in the gutter; layers (1-3) sets how many blocks per stream and tokens (3-5) how many streams.

fig_title.default: 残差流：每一层读入、写回

block_{i}.note: name of block i (bottom up) in the first stream

caption.default: 每个位置有一条残差流；每层的注意力与前馈块从流里读入，把结果加回。示意图，非真实模型。

margin_text.default: 因为每层都只是把输出加回残差流，层与层之间可以直接通信；后面的层读到的是前面所有层写入之和。

relations: Panel 1004 x 560 units at (96, 120), white, 1 unit hairline in the rule grey, radius 5; the title is 17 units bold centred; streams are 10-unit tile bars at equal steps with beige blocks (stone 2-unit outline) reading and writing through mauve arrows; token tiles are 46 units tall in the tile beige with mono 20-unit text.

Caption: bold 17-unit lead-in, then the sentence in the 80% ink under the panel; the margin gutter starts at x 1180, 324 units wide: a 60 x 76 thumbnail, a bold 16-unit title, 17-unit text in the 60% ink over up to five lines.
decoration: Streams, blocks, arrows and the thumbnail are decoration; token text, captions and notes are slots.

provenance.corpus: research-paper kit (examples/circuits-paper-kit): our own original interactive paper page in the circuits-paper grammar; all copy, features and numbers are labelled samples
provenance.experiment: styles/circuits-paper/style.json provenance (three public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: A bordered figure panel, a numbered caption with a bold lead-in and a gutter note with a thumbnail, with a residual-stream schematic drawn from parameters.
measured: Figure: the 2021 paper's gutter thumbnail beside the text and the 13 px numbered captions; the schematic is our own.
Template: 1-3 layers x 3-5 tokens, 50 seeds, light and dark pass.
